description: A rare variant of High Oak that appears when the Feywood is under sustained strain — dark-grained, dense, ritually significant. Its presence itself is a health-register indicator. Druids mark witheroak when it appears; living witheroak wood is never exported and is used only for specific ceremonial purposes during Feywood strain.

ecology.cultural_role: ritual marking; health-register indicator; specific ceremonial use
ecology.ecological_role: rare variant appearing under sustained Feywood strain

name: Witheroak
